eyebrow: See them all in one query
code:
SELECT name, database_id, create_date, state_desc
FROM sys.databases
WHERE database_id <= 4
ORDER BY database_id;
caption: Every SQL Server instance ships with these four, separate from AdventureWorks2012 or any user database.

eyebrow: Why tempdb matters more than it sounds
code:
-- Lesson 93's #temp tables and table variables
-- physically live here
SELECT name, physical_name, size * 8 / 1024 AS SizeMB
FROM tempdb.sys.database_files;
caption: Recreated from scratch on every SQL Server restart — a shared workspace, not permanent storage.
